notes: Method: all figures come from WebSearch (extended mode) result summaries dated September/October 2026; each record lists the URLs used. WebSearch returns an AI summary of pages, not the raw page, so a figure's exact publication date is often only 'as of September 2026'; the 'date' field in sources reflects the best available date. Fiscal-year convention: fyXXXX = fiscal year ENDING in calendar year XXXX (Japan/India March year-ends: fy2027 = Apr 2026-Mar 2027; Lasertec June year-end). For March year-end companies 'complete' means fy2027+fy2028 (the two unreported years), for December year-ends fy2026+fy2027. Prices: 30 Sep 2026 close where found; otherwise the latest close found with its exact date (Alchip 24 Sep, ASE 21 Sep, Aspeed 24 Sep, Elite Material 29 Sep, Disco 25 Sep, Hitachi 28 Sep, Hanwha 28 Sep, CATL 29 Sep, ST Engineering 25 Sep, BABA 29 Sep). Known data hazards: Tokyo Electron 5:1 split effective 1 Oct 2026 (price split-adjusted, EPS pre-split); Sanrio 5:1 split Apr 2026 (fy2028 only available pre-split, left null); MediaTek 30 Sep close 4,920 equals Elite Material's figure (confirmed by a second search but suspicious) and no 2027 consensus found; Unimicron Yahoo consensus looks stale vs Q2 run-rate; AVC 52-week range from search is inconsistent with price; Xiaomi/Pop Mart/Tencent/NetEase/PDD EPS are in CNY while prices are in HKD/USD - convert before computing P/E; Xiaomi 'market cap $657.20B' is almost certainly HKD. Market caps in USD given only where a USD figure was found; local-currency market caps are in 'notes'. Beta/yield/52w are from aggregator statistics pages and vary by provider. Zacks Rank only for US-listed ADRs where found (TSM #1, PDD #3, SE #4, BABA #5). Candidates with complete two-year forward consensus: 34 of 41 records (incomplete: MediaTek, Tokyo Electron, Disco, Ibiden, Sanrio, Alibaba, Persistent) (see summary in NOTES.md). Search budget used: 185 of 200 WebSearch calls; WebFetch/curl not attempted (blocked by policy).
